meta.title: AdxLens
meta.description: Evidence-backed Meta Ads reports for agencies

landing.title: Meta Ads reports with evidence, matching Ads Manager
landing.subtitle: Send clients agency-branded reports with numbers within 1% of Ads Manager, ready 10 minutes after you connect.
landing.assurance: Read-only data · No card required · Connect in minutes

match.title: Numbers that match
match.body: Every report carries a reconciliation line against Ads Manager. If the gap is over 1%, we block sending and tell you.

brand.title: Your agency's brand
brand.body: Your logo, colors and email. Clients open a link, no sign-up needed.

evidence.title: Findings with evidence
evidence.body: Every finding links to the source numbers so you can check them yourself. No numbers made up by AI.

steps.send: Check reconciliation and send the report

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.basis: Priced per active ad account (spend in the last 30 days), never as a % of ad spend. Extra account: {extra}/month. Pay yearly and save {discount}%. Prices exclude VAT.
pricing.breakEvenLink: Break-even page: hours saved per account × your hourly rate vs. the monthly fee. See the formula

free.name: Free
free.summary: Reports, public links, PDF. Includes a "Powered by AdxLens" label.

starter.name: Starter
starter.summary: Adds weekly recommendations, creative library, detailed reconciliation.

growth.name: Growth
growth.summary: Adds approved actions and automation rules (early access).

scale.name: Scale
scale.summary: Adds full white-label: remove the "Powered by" label, priority support.

read.title: Data we read
read.body: Campaign, ad set and ad metrics, spend and results from the ad accounts you authorize. We never write or change anything on Meta.

store.title: How we store it
store.body: Access tokens are encrypted and used only to sync metrics. We never store your Meta password.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: Disconnect at any time and ask us to delete your data. See the <link>data deletion guide</link>.

service.title: 1. The service
service.body: AdxLens provides reports and analysis from the Meta Ads data you give it read access to.

responsibility.title: 2. Responsibility to your clients
responsibility.body: You are responsible for the reports you send to your clients. Reports whose numbers differ from Ads Manager by more than 1% cannot be shared.

billing.title: 3. Billing and grace period
billing.body: Fees are per active account. If a payment fails, data keeps syncing during the grace period.

deletion.title: Data deletion guide
deletion.intro: There are two ways to ask us to delete the data AdxLens stored from your Meta account.

inApp.title: Option 1: In AdxLens
inApp.body: Connections › choose the connection › "Disconnect and delete data". We email you a confirmation once deletion is complete.

fromFacebook.title: Option 2: From Facebook
fromFacebook.body: Settings › Apps and websites › AdxLens › Remove. Meta forwards the request to us and we delete the data within 30 days.

track.title: Track a request
track.body: Enter your confirmation code to see the deletion status.
track.notFound: No request found for this code. Check the code in your confirmation email.

status.pending: Request received, waiting to be processed.
status.cancelled: The request was cancelled because the account was reconnected.

breakEven.title: Break-even with AdxLens
breakEven.intro: Estimate the time your team saves on account checks and client reports with AdxLens, compared with the monthly fee.
breakEven.hours: Hours saved per account per month
breakEven.hoursHint: Checking numbers, reviewing account issues, building client reports.
breakEven.threshold: You break even when your hourly cost is {rate} or more.
breakEven.formula: Formula: accounts × hours saved per account × hourly cost − fee of the cheapest plan that covers your accounts. Never a % of ad spend.

disconnect.title: Meta connections
disconnect.dialogBody: The access token is deleted immediately and syncing stops. Synced ad data for {count, plural, one {# ad account} other {# ad accounts}} will be deleted after {days} days (committed within {deadline} days). Report links using these accounts are locked. Reconnecting before then cancels the deletion.
disconnect.facebookHint: To remove AdxLens's permission on Facebook entirely: Settings › Apps and websites › AdxLens › Remove.
disconnect.understand: I understand the data will be deleted
disconnect.pendingBanner: Data deletion pending (code {code}): deleting on {date}. Reconnect before then to cancel.
disconnect.doneBanner: Data of the old connection was deleted (code {code}) on {date}.

creative_fatigue.name: Creative fatigue
creative_fatigue.why: Frequency rose {freqRise, number}% (to {freq, number}) while CTR fell {ctrDrop, number}% versus the previous 7 days.
creative_fatigue.what: Refresh the creative, or lower this ad's budget while preparing a new one.

budget_misallocation.name: Spend concentrated on low performance
budget_misallocation.why: This ad set takes {share, number}% of spend for its goal but its CPA is {ratio, number}× the median of ad sets with the same goal.
budget_misallocation.what: Shift budget to ad sets near or below the median CPA; review this ad set's audience and creative.
budget_misallocation.impact: 7-day spend × (1 − median CPA / ad set CPA)

starved_winner.name: Starved winner
starved_winner.why: CPA is {better, number}% better than its ad set, yet the ad gets only {share, number}% of the ad set's spend.
starved_winner.what: Move this ad into its own ad set, or turn off weaker ads so budget reaches the winner.

fragmentation.name: Fragmented ad sets
fragmentation.why: {weak}/{total} active ad sets have small budgets or limited learning; none gets enough events to optimise.
fragmentation.what: Merge small ad sets with similar audiences, or use campaign budget (CBO) so Meta can allocate.

learning_limited.name: Learning limited
learning_limited.why: Meta reports this ad set as "learning limited": {results, number} results in 7 days; about {needed, number}/week are needed to exit learning.
learning_limited.whyInferred: This ad set had only {results, number} results in 7 days, below the ~{needed, number}/week Meta needs to exit learning.
learning_limited.what: Merge with ad sets targeting the same audience, raise the budget, or optimise for a more frequent event.

spend_no_conversion.name: Spend without conversions
spend_no_conversion.why: This ad set spent on {days, number} days last week with no results, while other ad sets with the same goal still convert.
spend_no_conversion.what: Pause or cut this ad set's budget; review audience, landing page and optimisation event.

account_hygiene.name: Account hygiene
account_hygiene.whyName: An active item has a default or copy name: "{name}".
account_hygiene.whyIdle: Active but spent nothing in the last 7 days.
account_hygiene.what: Use clear names and turn off unused items.
account_hygiene.whatName: Follow a naming convention (product · audience · creative) so reports are easier to read.
account_hygiene.whatIdle: Check schedule, budget and review status; turn it off if no longer used.

conversion_tracking.name: Conversion tracking
conversion_tracking.why: Results over the last {days, number} days fell {drop, number}% versus the previous 14 days while spend and link clicks did not fall accordingly.
conversion_tracking.what: Check the pixel/Conversions API and events in Events Manager; look for recent landing page changes.

reconciliation.body: Real ad accounts (no demo data, no disconnected connections) with days off Meta by more than 1% in the period. The 1% threshold is fixed; status comes from computed reconciliation results. Sharing is blocked when a day is off or the Client assignment is unconfirmed (same rule as reports).

creatives.footnote: Source: Meta Marketing API, {from} → {to}, in the account time zone. Classes follow public rules; a "forecast" is an estimate from the CTR trend, not a conclusion.

weekly.title: This week's actions
weekly.scoreNote: Rank = estimated impact (vs the account 7-day spend) × confidence ÷ effort. Suggestion types often marked "wrong" rank lower.
weekly.skipBody: A reason helps AdxLens rank suggestions better in later weeks.
weekly.emptyBody: The list is created every Monday at 07:00 from last week's findings and creatives.
weekly.noneFilteredBody: Change the status or clear "Assigned to me".
weekly.footnote: Suggestions are for reference only; AdxLens does not change anything in your accounts. Data follows each account time zone.

actions.creative_loser: Pause or reduce delivery for the losing creative ({ads} ads)
actions.creative_winner: Shift more delivery to the winning creative

outcomes.title: Before / after results
outcomes.causality: Compares the 7 days before and the 7 days after the day an action was marked "Done" (that day excluded). This is not proof of cause: seasonality, budgets and other changes also move the numbers.
outcomes.notMeasuredBody: This action type has no before / after metric.
outcomes.emptyBody: Mark actions "Done" in This week's actions to follow their results.

welcome.title: Hi {name}, get started with AdxLens
welcome.intro: Nothing to set up. AdxLens already reads the ad accounts you handle and prepares your weekly actions.
welcome.noClients: No clients assigned yet. Ask the owner to assign clients to you.
welcome.step1: Open "This week's actions": {count} waiting, ranked by impact.
welcome.step2: Assigned to you: {count}. Update the status when done.
welcome.step3: Check "Creatives" for winners, losers and creatives about to fatigue.

writeAccess.title: Write access on Meta
writeAccess.done: Write access granted. Every change still needs approval each time.
writeAccess.missingScope: Meta did not grant "manage ads". Try again and allow this permission.
writeAccess.planRequired: Approving actions on Meta is available on Growth and above.

what.approve: Only make a change after an authorised person approves it, with an exact before / after preview.
what.actions: Only: pause / resume ads or ad sets, adjust ad set daily budget (max ±15% each time), duplicate an ad set (copy stays paused).
what.guardrails: Always check safety limits, read the state back from Meta after each change and keep a full log.
what.revoke: You can revoke write access at any time; it takes effect immediately.

writeAccess.noConnectionsBody: Connect Meta before granting write access.
writeAccess.revokeConfirm: Revoke write access for this connection? Pending actions will not run.

guardrails.title: Guardrails
guardrails.intro: Safety limits for every change AdxLens makes on Meta. Fixed values are the maximum; you can only make them stricter.
guardrails.maxActionsPerDay: Max actions per day per account
guardrails.minDataDays: Minimum days of data before a change
guardrails.breakerFailures: Lock the account after consecutive failures
guardrails.excludeMetaIds: Never change (campaign / ad set / ad IDs)
guardrails.looser: Values can only be stricter than the fixed ones.

actionLog.title: Action log
actionLog.emptyBody: Changes approved from "This week's actions" appear here.
actionLog.failedBody: The action failed: {reason}. No change was kept on Meta.
actionLog.checkManually: Could not confirm whether the copy was created. Please check in Ads Manager.
actionLog.noUndoDuplicate: Duplicates cannot be undone automatically; pause or delete the copy in Ads Manager if needed.
actionLog.undoBody: AdxLens will return the item to its previous state, through the same safety checks.

errors.KILL_SWITCH_ACTIVE: All changes are paused (kill switch, or the account is locked after repeated failures).
errors.PLAN_REQUIRED: Requires the Growth plan or higher.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You cannot approve this action, or the connection has no write access.
errors.CONFLICT: The action is already running or no longer applies.

killSwitch.title: Kill switch
killSwitch.body: Turning on the kill switch immediately stops every change AdxLens makes on Meta for this workspace and cancels pending actions.
killSwitch.globalOn: The system-wide kill switch is on: all changes on Meta are paused.
killSwitch.confirmBody: Pending actions are canceled and no new action runs until you turn it off.
killSwitch.onToast: Kill switch on, {count} pending actions canceled

approve.title: Approve action
approve.manualOnly: This suggestion needs to be done manually in Ads Manager.
approve.queued: Approved. AdxLens is applying and verifying it on Meta.
approve.beforeNote: "Before" is from the latest sync. If the item has changed on Meta, AdxLens stops and does not overwrite it.
approve.safety: AdxLens checks the safety limits, applies the change once, then reads Meta back to verify.
approve.noPermission: You are not allowed to approve actions for this client. The owner can grant it in Settings › Members.

warnings.not_undoable: This action cannot be undone automatically.
warnings.learning_reset: Changing the budget may send the ad set back into learning.
warnings.last_active_ad: This is the last active ad in the ad set: the ad set will stop delivering.

violations.excluded: The item is on the never-change list.
violations.too_many_actions: Reached the limit of {max} actions today for this account.
violations.no_daily_budget: The ad set does not use a daily budget.

approve.bulkNote: Only executable suggestions without guardrail violations are sent. Each action is still re-checked, executed and verified as with single approval; see results in the Action log.

automation.title: Automation rules
automation.emptyBody: Create a rule from a template. New rules always run in shadow for at least 14 days before acting for real.

templates.pause_adset_no_results: Pause ad sets spending without results
templates.reduce_budget_high_cpa: Cut budget of ad sets with rising CPA
templates.increase_budget_winner: Increase budget of winning ad sets (CPA down sharply)

automation.pctHint: From −15 to +15. Increases need a cap.
automation.maxPerDayHint: Can only be lower than the workspace limit.
automation.shadowNote: A new rule only records what it would do (shadow). After at least 14 days you can turn it live; every change still goes through safety limits and the kill switch.
automation.backtestNote: The backtest uses stored data, not Meta; real results may differ.

liveBlockers.feature_disabled: Automatic actions are not enabled for this workspace.
liveBlockers.plan_required: Requires the Growth plan or higher.
liveBlockers.shadow_too_short: Needs 14 days in shadow before going live.

automation.noEvaluationsBody: Rules are evaluated every 30 minutes on synced data.
automation.liveConfirm: Go live? AdxLens will make changes on Meta automatically when the rule matches, within safety limits.

errors.GUARDRAIL_VIOLATION: Outside safety limits: budget change max ±15%, limits can only be stricter than the workspace.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Check the conditions / action (increases need a cap; level must match the action).

results.note: Last 30 days. "Spend in the 7 days before pausing" is what the item spent in the 7 days before the rule paused it — for reference only, not proof of real savings. Undo rate target ≤ 5%.
results.emptyBody: Live rules show their results here.

automation.maxRequired: Required for budget increases: the new budget never exceeds this.

copy.title: Copy rule "{name}"
copy.note: Each copy is a separate rule for one account and starts with a 14-day trial run. Exclusions are not copied.

entity.title: Object detail
entity.adsetScope: Breakdown data comes from the ad set containing this ad.
entity.noFindings: No open issues on this object.
entity.noHistory: No changes made through AdxLens yet.
entity.noHistoryBody: Changes approved from Weekly actions or made by automation rules appear here.

gridActions.note: Each action is checked against guardrails, executed on Meta and verified; only objects without violations are sent. Follow results in the

parentPaused.campaign: Turn on the campaign first (Ads Manager)
parentPaused.adset: Turn on the ad set first

gridActions.failed: {count} actions could not be submitted — see the reason on each item.
